claims.subject: ifc6309-329
claims.value: Android 6.0.1/API 23; msm8916_64; build IFC-6309-2.0-MIR/329; fingerprint mirror/mirror/msm8916_64:6.0.1/IFC-6309-2.0-MIR/329:user/release-keys
claims.limits: Not our reconstructed fingerprint; no exact PCB/panel association established.
claims.validation_needed: Independent matching stock-unit properties plus redacted board label.

claims.subject: ifc6309-329
claims.value: Maintainer describes 1 GB RAM, 8 GB eMMC, 1920x1080 physical / 1080x1920 logical display and security patch string 2016-02-01.
claims.limits: Those rows are not additional status predicates in that project; not universal MIRROR specifications.
claims.validation_needed: Read-only independent memory/storage/display observations tied to PCB and firmware.

claims.subject: ifc6309-329
claims.value: External app-level reuse path requires authorized ADB and exact firmware checks; OS investigation reports locked signed boot and rejected generic boot/EDL candidates.
claims.locator: Installation prerequisites; Current hard blockers / non-writing boot-trust probes
claims.limits: Not a clean-stock universal authorization bypass or our system-replacement validation.
claims.validation_needed: Owner-approved reproduction of that exact external procedure and starting state.

claims.subject: mdme-unit
claims.value: Teardown author identifies APQ8016E/Snapdragon 410E, PM8916 and WCN3660B.
claims.limits: Do not collapse APQ8016E, APQ8016 and MSM8916 into proof of identical silicon/PCB.
claims.validation_needed: Legible chip photos and board label from an independently cataloged unit.

claims.subject: mdme-unit
claims.value: Micron marking 8ZA92 JZ099; author proposes a memory/storage package but does not identify capacity.
claims.limits: Package interpretation is the author's hypothesis, not a decoded part or capacity.
claims.validation_needed: Manufacturer marking decode and independent memory/storage observation.

claims.subject: mdme-unit
claims.value: Author identifies OV5640 camera assembly JAL-2721 V3.1 and Samsung LTI400HN01 40-inch 1920x1080 panel on this teardown.
claims.limits: One reported assembly, not a RevP21-to-panel mapping or a working driver test.
claims.validation_needed: Same-unit PCB/sensor/panel evidence and exact-artifact camera/display acceptance.

claims.subject: mdme-unit
claims.value: Author identifies CX20921 microphone processor, TPA3116D2 amplifier and MP118TX PSU.
claims.locator: Microphone, Audio Amp and Powersupply sections
claims.limits: Not verified routing, speaker power, rail pinout or electrical instructions.
claims.validation_needed: Component-label confirmation and separate route/driver observations; no powered probing for intake.

claims.subject: qualcomm-family
claims.value: Samsung-panel owner posts BOOT.BF.3.0-00280, InforceServer, IFC6309 DSI_LVDS and signed/locked boot log markers.
claims.limits: No exact PCB revision, Android fingerprint or successful unlock established by that log.
claims.validation_needed: Redacted label and complete contextual identity from that unit or independent matching unit.

claims.subject: qualcomm-family
claims.value: Qualcomm documents Snapdragon 410E as APQ8016E; vendor specification is a component reference, not a MIRROR BOM.
claims.limits: Does not establish which chip is fitted to another unit.
claims.validation_needed: Per-unit chip/firmware evidence before applying component assumptions.

claims.subject: inforce-6309
claims.value: Inforce announced V3.0 Android 7.1.1 on kernel 3.10.49 with IFC6309 LVDS support in April 2018.
claims.locator: Release introduction and IFC6309 additional features
claims.limits: Reference-platform BSP, not MIRROR-signed firmware, downloadable package availability or tested upgrade.
claims.validation_needed: Lawful package, exact board/device-tree and signer/ABI review before any target testing.

claims.subject: nxp-280415-lead
claims.value: Owner thread transcribes 280415-3 REV A and links PCB photos.
claims.locator: 2025-08-17 technical reply; linked albums O5JzObY / ftFHeXg
claims.limits: Thread-excerpt transcription, not our photo confirmation; no Rev08 equivalence inferred.
claims.validation_needed: Direct comment permalink and legible redacted same-unit PCB photo.

claims.subject: nxp-280415-lead
claims.value: Owner writeup identifies NXP i.MX8MM; JTAG configuration names mimx8mm6dvtlzaa.
claims.limits: Configured target name is not independent silicon readback or universal hardware identity.
claims.validation_needed: Chip marking plus same-unit board and runtime identity evidence.

claims.subject: nxp-280415-lead
claims.value: Owner thread shows mirror_v1_1 shell, kernel 5.4.47 aarch64 and uid 2000; boot log names android-10.0.0_2.5.0-20200918 ATF branch and January 2022 build.
claims.locator: 2025-08-15 shell transcript; opening boot log in part3a
claims.limits: ATF branch name is not proof of installed Android release/API; full Android fingerprint remains unknown.
claims.validation_needed: Allowlisted release/SDK/fingerprint observations tied to a redacted board report.

claims.subject: nxp-280415-lead
claims.value: First-person writeup uses soldered JTAG/live-memory access and owner-derived boot-chain material; later bootloader work is described.
claims.locator: Homepage approach; JTAG steps; part3a scope
claims.limits: Hardware-assisted research, not a validated software-only entry point, safe pinout or tested recipe here.
claims.validation_needed: Independent identity/provenance and a genuinely software-only initial-access proposal, reviewed without executing these instructions.

claims.subject: nxp-280415-lead
claims.value: NXP i.MX 8M Mini family documentation describes Cortex-A53/Cortex-M4, MIPI DSI/CSI and USB 2.0 OTG.
claims.limits: Silicon capability is not proof of board wiring, ports, available cores, clock or drivers.
claims.validation_needed: Board-specific BOM/device-tree and stock-driver evidence.

claims.subject: rev08-lead
claims.value: Project author calls their unit Rev08, ordered November 2022, with BOE DV430FHM-NN5.
claims.limits: Rev08 label namespace/SoC not established; not equated with NXP or RevP21.
claims.validation_needed: Legible PCB/PCA and chip evidence from the same unit.

claims.subject: panel-boe
claims.value: BOE DV430FHM-NN5 is described as 43-inch; hardware-controller conversion is documented.
claims.limits: Replacement-TV-board result, not original-board software recovery; HV430FHB-N10 equivalence is not adopted as a pinout guarantee.
claims.validation_needed: Exact panel/TCON label and original-board display acceptance.

claims.subject: panel-lm40
claims.value: LM40SAMFHD700AG25WV is reported on MIRROR units; an owner reports replacement-controller display operation.
claims.limits: Panel-only identification, no associated SoC/PCB/firmware inferred; not software-only success.
claims.validation_needed: Same-unit original PCB, panel and stock firmware identity.

claims.subject: panel-lti40
claims.value: Samsung LTI400HN01 is reported in teardown and owner accounts; issue 24 reports PS5 display via replacement-controller experimentation.
claims.limits: No interchangeable cable/controller guarantee; no original-board recovery inference.
claims.validation_needed: Exact label/PCB/stock display-driver association and separately approved testing.

claims.subject: revp1-lead
claims.value: Community README links photo albums under a RevP1 designation.
claims.limits: Unresolved designation; not normalized to RevP21 or assumed a distinct manufactured generation.
claims.validation_needed: Review legible original labels and establish which component the revision describes.

claims.subject: panel-boe
claims.value: One owner reports both 2021 and October 2022 purchases with BOE panels manufactured in 2021.
claims.limits: Purchase year, branding, screen size and reset-button anecdotes do not determine chipset or exact revision.
claims.validation_needed: Dated same-unit PCB/panel evidence; do not use resale dates as identity gates.

claims.subject: regulatory-2018
claims.value: Curiouser Smart Mirror FCC identifier 2AOSD-RLSYM1R0 has August 2018 application metadata and internal-photo exhibit 3965859.
claims.limits: Regulatory identity is not a mainboard revision; internal-photo PDF unread in this pass.
claims.validation_needed: Retrieve actual public exhibit and match legible labels to an owner unit before any BOM claim.

claims.subject: rflex-excluded
claims.value: An owner reports Rflex/Mentra by SATS with BOE DV430FHM-NN1 and touch functionality, comparing it to MIRROR.
claims.limits: Different product; not cataloged as a lululemon variant or source of its specifications.
claims.validation_needed: Keep out of MIRROR combinations unless independent manufacturer/board equivalence is established.

claims.subject: mdme-unit
claims.value: TI specifies TPA3116D2 as an analog-input Class-D amplifier; rated power depends on supply/load conditions.
claims.limits: IC maximum ratings are not MIRROR speaker power, volume settings or safe wiring instructions.
